# Worker Engine and Cyborg
Reuse canonical Cyborg/Worker admission, mission, capability, evidence and runtime paths. Verify worker identity/certification, trigger dedupe/cooldown, context scope, clarification, approvals/escalation, fallback risk, retry/idempotency, watchdog independence, audit lineage and stop/rollback. No direct provider/model bypass. Runtime, scheduler/heartbeat, automatic publishing, payments and consequential authority remain OFF unless explicitly authorized and commissioned. Global Stop may never be silently weakened.
